en.title: Radiant Light and a Seaside Dress Code
en.summary: The Spotlight Event runs from October 19, 20:00 to October 27, 19:59 JST. Play rhythm stages and minigames for Event Points and Badges. Chapters focus on Tokoyami Towa, Kaela Kovalskia, Shishiro Botan and Koseki Bijou. Points unlock short stories; exchange Badges for Event Memories and other items.
